result.notes: Two significant coding errors identified: (1) concept 1237484006 'Metastatic carcinoma TO colon' is clinically incorrect — it codes the colon as the secondary/metastatic site, whereas the patient has primary colon cancer with liver metastases; it should be replaced with 363406005 'Malignant neoplasm of colon (disorder)'. (2) concept 174431000 'Wedge resection of liver' is an unsupported level of specificity — the note states only 'Liver resection' without specifying wedge type; the broader 107963000 'Excision of liver (procedure)' is more appropriate. Additionally, liver metastasis (94381002) and the eMED3 fit note finding (751481000000104) are missing from the coded list."
